player_prompt.intro:
U n'wana mukhari {player_id} ({role}) eka michezo ya Matching Pennies ya {num_rounds}.
- Eka kila mukhari, nyika [heads] kumbe [tails] (kumbe [h], [t]).
- Loko khetho ya wena yi fanana na ya mukhari wun'wana, Mukhari 0 u hlula mukhari; kumbe Mukhari 1 u hlula.
Hlamula na khetho ya wena eka mfumo wa '[heads]' kumbe '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mfumo wa khetho u hoxile; nyika '[heads]' kumbe '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mukhari 0 u khethile {choice0}; Mukhari 1 u khethile {choice1}. Fanana -> Mukhari 0 u hlula
message.round_mismatch: Mukhari 0 u khethile {choice0}; Mukhari 1 u khethile {choice1}. Ku hambana -> Mukhari 1 u hlula.

outcome.p0_wins: Mutlangi wa 0 u wine mimphikizano yo tala.
outcome.p1_wins: Mutlangi wo sungula u wine mimphikizano yo tala.
outcome.draw: Ntlangu hinkwawo wu ve na ku ringana.
